svg.aria-label: MKEvolve kernel synthesis on the KernelBench L3 ConvolutionalVisionTransformer task over five outer-loop iterations. Left panel (a): the subproblem decomposition topology evolves across iterations. In iterations 1 and 2 the module is split into five subkernels; subkernel 4, the Transformer Encoder, fails (red cross). In iterations 3 and 4 subkernel 4 is decomposed into Self-Attention (4a) and Feed-forward (4b), both now correct. In iteration 5, 4a and 4b are fused into a single Transformer Block subkernel (4c), reducing the kernel count from five to four. Right panel (b): per-subkernel and end-to-end (E2E) speedup relative to torch.compile as the number of generated kernels grows from 32 to 160. The dashed E2E curve rises from failure to about 0.53 once subproblem 4 is decomposed into 4a and 4b, then climbs toward 1.0 after 4a and 4b are fused into the Transformer Block 4c.
svg.text: (a) the decomposition topology evolves: subproblem 4 splits into 4a / 4b, then fuses into 4c
(b) end-to-end speedup climbs from failure as the structure is refined
a failing subproblem is split, then its children are fused; the E2E curve tracks each structural change
